definitions.explanation: A ticket purchased before the day of an event, typically at a discounted price compared to tickets sold at the door.

examples.japanese: {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{前売|まえう}り{券|けん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}→当日券：08287_toujitsuken⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Advance tickets are cheaper than same-day tickets.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前売|まえう}り{券|けん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}→発売開始：22166_hatsubaikaishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{数分|すうふん}→数分：21623_suufun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The advance tickets for the concert sold out within minutes of going on sale.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{前売|まえう}り→前売り：08289_maeuri⟧ (advance sale) and ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket). Advance tickets are standard in Japan for concerts, movies, exhibitions, and theme parks, and usually offer a discount over ⟦{当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}→当日券：08287_toujitsuken⟧ (same-day tickets).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy an advance ticket)
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れる→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧ (advance tickets sell out)
- {前売|まえう}り{券|けん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ (release of advance tickets)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}→当日券：08287_toujitsuken⟧: same-day ticket — purchased on the day of the event
- ⟦{指定|してい}{席|せき}{券|けん}→指定席券：17902_shiteisekiken⟧: reserved seat ticket — specifies a seat number
